github:basics.description: A quiz on Git and GitHub basics: the index and commits, branches, fetch/pull, .gitignore, merge conflicts, remotes and forks, Pull Requests, tags, undoing changes, stash, Git Flow and trunk-based development, LFS.

github:advanced.title: Git Advanced
github:advanced.description: A quiz on advanced Git: reflog and recovering commits, cherry-pick, squash and interactive rebase, filter-repo and history cleanup, force-with-lease, protected branches, bisect.

github:workflow.description: A quiz on GitHub Actions: workflows, jobs and steps, triggers, version and OS matrices, contexts and conditions, token permissions and secrets, reusable workflows, path filters, caching, timeouts, and badges.

ml:timeseries.title: Time Series
ml:timeseries.description: A quiz on time series: components and validation, stationarity and ADF, differencing, ACF/PACF, exponential smoothing, ARIMA/SARIMA/SARIMAX, metrics, Prophet, and neural network models.

ml:recsys.title: Recommender Systems
ml:recsys.description: A quiz on recommender systems: retrieval and ranking, collaborative filtering and matrix factorization, sequential models, losses and metrics, graph models, exploration, bias, cold start, search vs. recommendation, LLMs.

mlops:k8s.title: Kubernetes
mlops:k8s.description: A quiz on Kubernetes: the control plane and nodes, Pods and Services, manifests, Deployments and ReplicaSets, requests and limits, probes, ConfigMaps and Secrets, HPA, GPUs, Jobs, and a comparison with Docker Compose.

mlops:kafka.title: Apache Kafka
mlops:kafka.description: A quiz on Kafka: topics and partitions, ordering and keys, consumer groups and offsets, delivery guarantees, retention and compaction, replication, ML patterns, Schema Registry, Connect, Streams and ksqlDB, monitoring.

ml:dl:block-1.title: DL · Block 1: neurons, backprop and optimizers
ml:dl:block-1.description: Check before block 2: the McCulloch-Pitts neuron, MLP, activation functions, forward and backward pass, SGD, Momentum, AdaGrad, RMSProp, Adam, AdamW.

ml:dl:block-2.title: DL · Block 2: generalization and training in practice
ml:dl:block-2.description: Check before block 3: overfitting and underfitting, label smoothing, weight initialization, fine-tuning, warm-up and schedules, hyperparameters, data drift and concept drift.

ml:dl:block-3.title: DL · Block 3: BatchNorm, Dropout and multicollinearity
ml:dl:block-3.description: Check before block 4: Batch Normalization, Dropout, feature multicollinearity.

ml:dl:block-4.title: DL · Block 4: convolutions, RNNs and GPU training
ml:dl:block-4.description: Check before block 5: convolution and pooling, vanishing and exploding gradients, residual connections, augmentation, RNN/LSTM/GRU, single- and multi-GPU training, saving GPU memory.

ml:dl:block-5.title: DL · Block 5: embeddings and attention
ml:dl:block-5.description: Check before block 6: embeddings, attention, self-, cross-, causal and masked attention, multi-head attention, attention complexity.

ml:dl:block-6.title: DL · Block 6: transformers
ml:dl:block-6.description: Final check on transformers: the block structure, encoder-only and decoder-only models, LayerNorm, pre-norm and post-norm.

github:basics:block-1.title: Git · Block 1: Git, GitHub and first setup
github:basics:block-1.description: Check before block 2: Git and GitHub, GitHub Desktop, VS Code extensions, GitHub vs GitLab, diff, git config, git init.

github:basics:block-2.title: Git · Block 2: the index, commits and branches
github:basics:block-2.description: Check before block 3: git status, git add, git commit, branches, git checkout and git switch.

github:basics:block-3.title: Git · Block 3: fetch, pull and .gitignore
github:basics:block-3.description: Check before block 4: git fetch and git pull, the basic add → commit → push cycle, .gitignore.

github:basics:block-4.title: Git · Block 4: history, conflicts and remotes
github:basics:block-4.description: Check before block 5: git log, git show, git blame, merging and resolving conflicts, remotes, push -u.

github:basics:block-5.title: Git · Block 5: forks, PRs, tags and undoing changes
github:basics:block-5.description: Check before block 6: clone and fork, upstream, Pull Requests, tags and releases, restore, reset, revert, stash.

github:basics:block-6.title: Git · Block 6: branching models, rebase and LFS
github:basics:block-6.description: Final check for block 6: Git Flow, Trunk-Based Development, issues, rebase, README and LICENSE, Git LFS.

github:workflow:block-8.title: GitHub Actions · Block 8: workflows, triggers and matrices
github:workflow:block-8.description: Check before block 9: workflow structure, jobs and steps, badges, push, pull_request, schedule and workflow_dispatch triggers, Python version and OS matrices.

github:workflow:block-9.title: GitHub Actions · Block 9: multiple workflows, contexts and permissions
github:workflow:block-9.description: Check before block 10: splitting CI, lint and nightly into files, contexts and expressions, if conditions, secrets, permissions and pinning actions.

github:workflow:block-10.title: GitHub Actions · Block 10: reusable workflows, path filters and timeouts
github:workflow:block-10.description: Final check for block 10: workflow_call, passing inputs and secrets, paths and paths-ignore in a monorepo, timeout-minutes, continue-on-error and retries.

db:postgresql:block-1.title: PostgreSQL · Block 1: the DBMS, types, constraints and normalization
db:postgresql:block-1.description: Check before block 2: what PostgreSQL is and connection pooling, OLTP vs OLAP, numeric vs float, timestamptz, jsonb, keys and constraints, upsert, normal forms, materialized views.

db:postgresql:block-2.title: PostgreSQL · Block 2: JOINs, aggregates, NULL and windows
db:postgresql:block-2.description: Check before block 3: JOIN types and fan-out, ON vs WHERE, GROUP BY and HAVING, the three COUNTs, NULL and NOT IN, CTEs and subqueries, window functions, point-in-time joins.

db:postgresql:block-3.title: PostgreSQL · Block 3: EXPLAIN, indexes and MVCC
db:postgresql:block-3.description: Check before block 4: EXPLAIN and EXPLAIN ANALYZE, scan types, B-tree, composite, GIN and BRIN indexes, MVCC, bloat, VACUUM and ANALYZE.

db:postgresql:block-4.title: PostgreSQL · Block 4: isolation, Python and pgvector
db:postgresql:block-4.description: Final check for block 4: isolation levels and locks, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, working from Python (parameters, transactions, COPY, chunks), pgvector, IVFFlat and HNSW.

db:redis:block-1.title: Redis · Block 1: internals, data types and atomicity
db:redis:block-1.description: Check before block 2: why Redis is fast and single-threaded, String, Hash, List, Set, Sorted Set, big keys, INCR, pipeline, MULTI/EXEC, WATCH and Lua.

db:redis:block-2.title: Redis · Block 2: TTL and eviction
db:redis:block-2.description: Check before block 3: TTL and the commands that reset it, lazy and active expiry, maxmemory, allkeys and volatile policies, LRU and LFU.

db:redis:block-3.title: Redis · Block 3: caching patterns and ML caches
db:redis:block-3.description: Check before block 4: cache-aside, read-through, write-through and write-behind, invalidation and key versioning, stampede, penetration and avalanche, caching predictions, embeddings and online features.

db:redis:block-4.title: Redis · Block 4: persistence, clustering, queues and Python
db:redis:block-4.description: Final check for block 4: RDB and AOF, fork and copy-on-write, replication, Sentinel and Redis Cluster, List queues, Pub/Sub and Streams, Celery, the redis-py client and async.

math:algebra:block-2.title: Algebra · Block 2: numbers, vectors, matrices and tensors
math:algebra:block-2.description: Check before block 3: number sets, operations on numbers, vectors, the dot product and cosine similarity, matrix multiplication and transposition, tensors.

math:algebra:block-3.title: Algebra · Block 3: vector spaces and bases
math:algebra:block-3.description: Check before block 4: vector spaces, linear combinations and span, basis and dimension, subspaces, linear dependence and independence.

math:algebra:block-4.title: Algebra · Block 4: elementary operations, rank and types of matrices
math:algebra:block-4.description: Check before block 5: elementary row operations, matrix rank, types of matrices.

math:algebra:block-5.title: Algebra · Block 5: determinant, eigenvalues and SVD
math:algebra:block-5.description: Final check on the determinant, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, SVD and Truncated SVD.

math:calculus:block-6.title: Calculus · Block 6: sets, functions and limits
math:calculus:block-6.description: Check before block 7: sets and set operations, functions of one and several variables, composition, sequences and limits, continuity.

math:calculus:block-7.title: Calculus · Block 7: derivatives, extrema and the gradient
math:calculus:block-7.description: Check before block 8: derivatives of functions of one and several variables, approximation, smoothness, extrema, the gradient.

math:calculus:block-8.title: Calculus · Block 8: metrics and norms
math:calculus:block-8.description: Final check on metrics and norms: metric axioms, Euclidean and Manhattan distance, $L_1$, $L_2$, $L_\infty$ norms and regularization.

math:probability:block-9.title: Probability · Block 9: random variables and distributions
math:probability:block-9.description: Check before block 10: discrete and continuous random variables, the probability mass function, density, the normal, exponential, Bernoulli and Poisson distributions.

math:probability:block-10.title: Probability · Block 10: moments, conditional probability and samples
math:probability:block-10.description: Check before block 11: expectation, variance and standard deviation, joint and conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, population and sample, sample mean and variance, mode, median.

math:probability:block-11.title: Probability · Block 11: hypotheses, intervals and A/B tests
math:probability:block-11.description: Check before block 12: bootstrap, statistical hypotheses and the $p$-value, confidence intervals, type I and type II errors, parametric and non-parametric tests, the $t$-test, A/B testing.

math:probability:block-12.title: Probability · Block 12: quantiles, box plots and heteroscedasticity
math:probability:block-12.description: Check before block 13: quantiles, quartiles and percentiles, the interquartile range, box plots, homoscedasticity and heteroscedasticity.

math:probability:block-13.title: Probability · Block 13: covariance and correlation
math:probability:block-13.description: Check before block 14: the multivariate normal distribution, covariance, covariance matrices, Pearson and Spearman correlation.

math:probability:block-14.title: Probability · Block 14: CLT and the law of large numbers
math:probability:block-14.description: Final check on the central limit theorem and the law of large numbers.

linux:basics:block-1.title: Linux · Block 1: why Linux and the command line
linux:basics:block-1.description: Check before block 2: Linux for ML engineers, `man` and `--help`, Warp, the command line.

linux:basics:block-2.title: Linux · Block 2: files, paths, search and disk
linux:basics:block-2.description: Check before block 3: working with files and folders, absolute and relative paths, viewing files, `find` and `grep`, `df` and `du`, archives.

linux:basics:block-3.title: Linux · Block 3: resources, processes, tmux and logs
linux:basics:block-3.description: Check before block 4: resource monitoring, processes and `kill`, background jobs, `nohup` and output redirection, `tmux`, working with logs.

linux:basics:block-4.title: Linux · Block 4: SSH, permissions and environments
linux:basics:block-4.description: Check before block 5: SSH connections, `scp` and `rsync`, permissions, symbolic links, environment variables, Python environments on a server.

linux:basics:block-5.title: Linux · Block 5: GPUs, memory and launching training
linux:basics:block-5.description: Final check on GPUs and launching training: `nvidia-smi`, `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, CUDA OOM and RAM OOM, ML library caches, the pre-launch checklist.

ml:classic:block-1.title: Classic ML · Block 1: tasks, loss functions and metrics
ml:classic:block-1.description: Check before block 2: supervised learning, data splits, classification and regression, loss functions and empirical risk, classification and regression metrics, ROC AUC, threshold selection, error quantiles, conformal prediction, $D^2$.

ml:classic:block-2.title: Classic ML · Block 2: validation, regularization and data preparation
ml:classic:block-2.description: Check before block 3: cross-validation, stratification, k-Fold, LOO, regularization, hyperparameters, bias-variance, train/validation/test, EDA, preprocessing, feature scaling, categorical encoding, imputation, SMOTE, RFECV, Bayesian optimization.

ml:classic:block-3.title: Classic ML · Block 3: logistic regression, trees and bagging
ml:classic:block-3.description: Check before block 4: logistic regression and softmax, decision trees, splitting criteria, regression trees, pros and cons of trees, tree regularization, bagging.

ml:classic:block-4.title: Classic ML · Block 4: Random Forest, boosting and stacking
ml:classic:block-4.description: Check before block 5: Random Forest, bagging and boosting, gradient boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost, stacking and blending, HistGradientBoosting.

ml:classic:block-5.title: Classic ML · Block 5: clustering and KNN
ml:classic:block-5.description: Check before block 6: the clustering problem and clustering metrics, KMeans, KMeans++, KMedoids, DBSCAN, hierarchical and spectral clustering, k-nearest neighbors.

ml:classic:block-6.title: Classic ML · Block 6: naive Bayes, SVM and dimensionality reduction
ml:classic:block-6.description: Final check on block 6: the naive Bayes classifier, SVM and the kernel trick, PCA, MDS, SNE and t-SNE, UMAP.

ml:cv-classic:block-1.title: Classic CV · Block 1: the image as data
ml:cv-classic:block-1.description: Check before block 2: the image as a tensor, HWC and CHW axis order, uint8 and float32, normalization, RGB and other color spaces, gamma, bit depth, dithering, window/level.

ml:cv-classic:block-2.title: Classic CV · Block 2: histogram, thresholding and morphology
ml:cv-classic:block-2.description: Check before block 3: the histogram, brightness, contrast and gamma, equalization and CLAHE, Otsu's method, adaptive thresholding, morphological operations.

ml:cv-classic:block-3.title: Classic CV · Block 3: convolution and linear filters
ml:cv-classic:block-3.description: Check before block 4: the Gaussian filter and separability, kernel size, unsharp masking, the median filter, the Sobel filter and atan2, the Gabor filter.

ml:cv-classic:block-4.title: Classic CV · Block 4: edges, corners and descriptors
ml:cv-classic:block-4.description: Check before block 5: the Canny edge detector, the Harris corner detector, SIFT and ORB keypoints and descriptors, the ratio test, HOG.

ml:cv-classic:block-5.title: Classic CV · Block 5: geometry, camera and stereo
ml:cv-classic:block-5.description: Check before block 6: affine transformations and warping, homography and RANSAC, panorama stitching, the pinhole camera model, calibration and distortion, stereo and epipolar geometry.

ml:cv-classic:block-6.title: Classic CV · Block 6: Fourier and compression
ml:cv-classic:block-6.description: Final check on the frequency representation and compression: the 2D DFT, amplitude and phase, the convolution theorem, spectral leakage and ringing, the cosine transform and JPEG.

ml:timeseries:block-1.title: Time Series · Block 1: series, components and validation
ml:timeseries:block-1.description: Check before block 2: what a time series is, the forecast horizon, trend, seasonality, cycle, noise and outliers, additive and multiplicative forms, temporal split, backtesting and future leakage.

ml:timeseries:block-2.title: Time Series · Block 2: stationarity, variance, differencing, ACF/PACF
ml:timeseries:block-2.description: Check before block 3: weak stationarity and how to diagnose it, heteroscedasticity, the log and Box-Cox transforms, ordinary and seasonal differencing, ACF and PACF.

ml:timeseries:block-3.title: Time Series · Block 3: forecasting models
ml:timeseries:block-3.description: Final check on forecasting models: exponential smoothing, Holt and Holt-Winters, AR, MA, ARMA, ARIMA, SARIMA, SARIMAX, Prophet and LSTM.

ml:recsys:block-1.title: RecSys · Block 1: basics, matrix factorization and retrieval
ml:recsys:block-1.description: Check before block 2: types of recommendations and feedback, collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, ALS and WRMF, the two-stage scheme, Two-Tower, negatives.

ml:recsys:block-2.title: RecSys · Block 2: ranking, sequences and losses
ml:recsys:block-2.description: Check before block 3: ranking and Learning to Rank, attention-based ranking, sequential recommendation, SASRec, BERT4Rec, GRU4Rec, pointwise, pairwise and listwise losses.

ml:recsys:block-3.title: RecSys · Block 3: metrics, embeddings and graphs
ml:recsys:block-3.description: Check before block 4: Precision@K, Recall@K, DCG and NDCG, beyond-accuracy metrics, multimodal embeddings, self-supervised learning, LightGCN and PinSage.

ml:recsys:block-4.title: RecSys · Block 4: exploration, bias and cold start
ml:recsys:block-4.description: Check before block 5: exploration and exploitation, bandits and RL, popularity, position and exposure bias, fairness and attacks, cold start and hybrid recommendation, early and late fusion.

ml:recsys:block-5.title: RecSys · Block 5: industrial design, experiments and search
ml:recsys:block-5.description: Check before block 6: multi-stage architecture and re-ranking, A/B tests, interleaving, IPS, monitoring, how search and recommendation relate, semantic search.

ml:recsys:block-6.title: RecSys · Block 6: LLMs, foundation models and key papers
ml:recsys:block-6.description: Final check on LLMs and foundation models in recommendations and key RecSys papers: the roles of LLMs in the pipeline, generative recommendation, CLIP-like models, YouTube DNN, SASRec, BERT4Rec.

ml:cv-dl:block-1.title: DL CV · Block 1: how CV tasks are structured
ml:cv-dl:block-1.description: Check before block 2: output format as the essence of a task, backbone, neck and head, stride and small objects, backbone fine-tuning, annotation formats and noise, group split, threshold choice, calibration.

ml:cv-dl:block-2.title: DL CV · Block 2: classification and regression
ml:cv-dl:block-2.description: Check before block 3: multi-class and multi-label, PR-AUC under imbalance, micro and macro F1, fine-grained classification and the long tail, regression and cyclic quantities, metric learning, ArcFace.

ml:cv-dl:block-3.title: DL CV · Block 3: detection
ml:cv-dl:block-3.description: Check before block 4: IoU and its losses, TP and duplicates, AP and mAP, AR, DETR, Focal Loss, NMS and crowded scenes.

ml:cv-dl:block-4.title: DL CV · Block 4: segmentation
ml:cv-dl:block-4.description: Check before block 5: segmentation types, mask resizing, pixel accuracy, IoU and Dice, mIoU, Dice and Tversky loss, atrous convolutions, U-Net skips.

ml:cv-dl:block-5.title: DL CV · Block 5: geometry: pose and depth
ml:cv-dl:block-5.description: Check before block 6: keypoints and how they differ from detection, heatmaps, OKS, flipping with joint swapping, top-down and bottom-up, stereo, monocular depth, SILog, δ1.

ml:cv-dl:block-6.title: DL CV · Block 6: generative tasks
ml:cv-dl:block-6.description: Check before block 7: L2 blurring, diffusion (forward process, noise prediction, schedules, guidance, latent diffusion), FID, precision and recall, Inception Score.

ml:cv-dl:block-7.title: DL CV · Block 7: label-free and multimodal
ml:cv-dl:block-7.description: Check before block 8: Grad-CAM and map sanity checks, SimCLR, MoCo, BYOL, MAE, CLIP and zero-shot, the two-tower architecture, anomaly detection and its metrics.

ml:cv-dl:block-8.title: DL CV · Block 8: choosing the formulation
ml:cv-dl:block-8.description: Final check on choosing a CV task formulation: output format, constraints, crowd counting, area, defects without labels, the business metric.

ml:models-cv:block-1.title: CV Models · Block 1: AlexNet, ZFNet, VGG, GoogLeNet
ml:models-cv:block-1.description: Check before block 2: AlexNet (ReLU, dropout, top-5), ZFNet and feature visualization, VGG and stacked 3×3 convolutions, GoogLeNet, 1×1 convolutions, global average pooling.

ml:models-cv:block-2.title: CV Models · Block 2: ResNet, Inception, ResNeXt, DenseNet
ml:models-cv:block-2.description: Check before block 3: degradation and the residual block, convolution factorization and label smoothing in Inception, ResNeXt cardinality, DenseNet dense connections.

ml:models-cv:block-3.title: CV Models · Block 3: SENet, MobileNet, ShuffleNet, NASNet
ml:models-cv:block-3.description: Check before block 4: the SE block, depthwise separable convolution and its real speed, grouped convolution and channel shuffle, neural architecture search of a cell.

ml:models-cv:block-4.title: CV Models · Block 4: MobileNetV2 and EfficientNet
ml:models-cv:block-4.description: Check before block 5: the inverted residual block, linear bottleneck, ReLU6, compound scaling, EfficientNet-B0, Fused-MBConv and progressive learning in EfficientNetV2.

ml:models-cv:block-5.title: CV Models · Block 5: attention and transformers
ml:models-cv:block-5.description: Final check on attention and transformers in CV: CBAM, ViT, DeiT and the distillation token, Swin and windowed attention, ConvNeXt.

ml:models-dl:block-1.title: DL Models · Block 1: autoencoders and VAE
ml:models-dl:block-1.description: Check before block 2: the autoencoder and its bottleneck, the link to PCA, anomaly detection, denoising, sparse and contractive AE, VAE, reparameterization, posterior collapse.

ml:models-dl:block-2.title: DL Models · Block 2: GAN
ml:models-dl:block-2.description: Final check on GAN: generator–discriminator equilibrium, mode collapse, non-saturating loss, WGAN, conditional GAN, comparison with VAE.

ml:nlp-base:block-1.title: NLP Base · Block 1: NLP tasks, preprocessing and bag of words
ml:nlp-base:block-1.description: Check before block 2: NLP tasks, text preprocessing, one-hot, Bag of Words, distributional semantics, count-based methods.

ml:nlp-base:block-2.title: NLP Base · Block 2: co-occurrence, PPMI, LSA, TF-IDF and BM25
ml:nlp-base:block-2.description: Check before block 3: the co-occurrence matrix, PMI and PPMI, LSA, TF-IDF, BM25.

ml:nlp-base:block-3.title: NLP Base · Block 3: Word2Vec, GloVe, FastText and embedding evaluation
ml:nlp-base:block-3.description: Check before block 4: Word2Vec, Skip-Gram and CBOW, negative sampling, GloVe, FastText, comparing vectorizers, evaluating and interpreting embeddings.

ml:nlp-base:block-4.title: NLP Base · Block 4: text classification, RNNs and ELMo
ml:nlp-base:block-4.description: Check before block 5: text classification, generative and discriminative models, multilabel, RNN/LSTM/GRU, bidirectional RNNs, ELMo.

ml:nlp-base:block-5.title: NLP Base · Block 5: language modeling
ml:nlp-base:block-5.description: Check before block 6: what a language model is, the chain rule and left-to-right LMs, n-gram models and smoothing, neural LMs, training language models.

ml:nlp-base:block-6.title: NLP Base · Block 6: decoding, Seq2Seq and subword tokenization
ml:nlp-base:block-6.description: Check before block 8: text generation strategies, Seq2Seq and beam search, BPE, WordPiece, Unigram, SentencePiece, comparing tokenizers.

ml:nlp-base:block-8.title: NLP Base · Block 8: BERT, GPT and Sentence Transformers
ml:nlp-base:block-8.description: Check before block 9: BERT and MLM, BERT-like models, GPT and the KV cache, GPT-like models and in-context learning, Sentence Transformers.

ml:nlp-base:block-9.title: NLP Base · Block 9: generation metrics and LLM training stages
ml:nlp-base:block-9.description: Final check on generation metrics and LLM training: BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, perplexity, LLM-as-a-judge, pretrain, SFT, RLHF and DPO.

ml:nlp-optimization:block-1.title: NLP Optimization · Block 1: inference and distillation
ml:nlp-optimization:block-1.description: Check before block 2: what drives inference speed, memory-bound decoding, RPS and latency, TTFT, hard- and soft-label distillation, exposure bias, forward and reverse KL, MiniLLM, cross-tokenizer distillation.

ml:nlp-optimization:block-2.title: NLP Optimization · Block 2: quantization

ml:nlp-optimization:block-3.description: Check before block 4: speculative decoding, EAGLE, MTP drafters, dynamic and continuous batching, ragged tensors, KV cache.

ml:nlp-optimization:block-4.title: NLP Optimization · Block 4: LoRA and its variants
ml:nlp-optimization:block-4.description: Check before block 5: LoRA, QLoRA, LoRA+, VeRA, DoRA.

ml:nlp-advanced:block-2.description: Check before block 3: Mixture of Experts, the router and load balancing, active parameters, Matryoshka Embeddings.
